mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly increase in GDPC1 (demand) above 2% growth rate signals robust economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in expanding periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly UNRATE crossing below 4.0% triggers positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, reflecting improved labor market conditions and increased consumer spending.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns do not outperform baseline when UNRATE crosses below 4.0%, or t-test p-value exceeds 0.05 in such instances.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent upward momentum in GDPC1 (demand growth) and downward movement in FEDFUNDS (federal funds rate) signal accommodative monetary policy and robust demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth > 2% and FEDFUNDS decline > 0.5% in the same month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns fail to be positive when both proxies meet their respective thresholds, or interaction effect rank IC < 0.05 over a 6-month window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a sustained decline in FEDFUNDS below 4.5% intensifies accommodative monetary policy, amplifying S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns do not follow the predicted positive trend when in late-cycle expansion and FEDFUNDS < 4.5%, or regime condition is not met.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained monthly increases in INDPRO (supply index) above 105 for three consecutive months signal robust supply-side growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO fails to sustain increases or 60-day returns do not exceed baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly UNRATE rise above 4.5% triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, reflecting heightened labor market tightness and potential inflationary pressures.
failure_condition: 5-day returns do not turn negative when UNRATE crosses above 4.5%, or t-test p-value exceeds 0.05 in such instances.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous upward trends in GDPC1 (demand growth) and INDPRO (supply index) indicate expanding economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth > 1% and INDPRO increase > 0.5% in the same month
failure_condition: 20-day returns fail to be positive when both proxies meet their thresholds, or interaction effect rank IC < 0.05 over a 6-month window.

mechanism_narrative: In a contraction regime, a sudden decline in FEDFUNDS below 4.0% signals unexpected monetary easing, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns do not follow the predicted positive trend when in contraction regime and FEDFUNDS < 4.0%, or regime condition is not met.
